macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Global stocks edge higher after U.S. midterm elections
items.summary: World markets were mostly higher Wednesday after Democrats won majorities in both chambers of Congress. S&P 500 futures rose 0.2% and Dow futures gained 0.4%, while oil prices declined; investors awaited eurozone inflation data and the Bank of England’s policy decision.

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound as Nvidia and AI shares lift Nasdaq
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.4% Tuesday and the Nasdaq gained 0.8%, while the Dow fell 0.4%. Nvidia, Broadcom, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta helped offset declines in Apple and many other stocks.

items.title: Apple shares fall on margin warning
items.summary: Apple declined after warning that higher memory-chip costs could reduce profit margins despite reporting stronger quarterly revenue and earnings. The outlook added pressure to technology shares.

items.title: European stocks rise ahead of eurozone inflation data
items.summary: The STOXX Europe 600 gained 0.3%, supported by technology shares and Novo Nordisk. Novo Nordisk rose nearly 6% after reporting better-than-expected third-quarter operating profit and raising its full-year sales and profit forecasts.

items.title: Fed holds interest rates steady
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee reportedly kept its target rate at 3.75%-4.00% in a 10-2 vote, with two officials favoring a 25-basis-point increase. The committee upgraded its assessment of economic activity while maintaining concerns about persistent inflation.

items.title: Treasury refunding announcement and borrowing needs in focus
items.summary: Markets awaited the Treasury’s refunding details after the department projected $618 billion in privately held net marketable borrowing for October-December and $800 billion for January-March. The 10-year Treasury yield ended Tuesday at 4.95%, up from 4.91%.

items.title: AMD earnings support semiconductor sentiment
items.summary: AMD reported strong data-center growth and guidance that helped ease concerns about artificial-intelligence infrastructure demand, supporting European technology shares and broader chip-sector sentiment.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Crypto market slips; Bitcoin holds near $76,600
items.summary: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 0.6% to about $2.655 trillion over 24 hours. Bitcoin declined 0.3% to $76,585, Ethereum fell 0.1% to $2,255.66, while XRP gained 0.9% and BNB dropped 1.4%.[1]

items.title: SEC classifies Canton Coin as a digital commodity
items.summary: The SEC’s Division of Corporation Finance issued a no-action letter stating that Canton Coin can be treated as a digital commodity, a potentially significant development for U.S. crypto regulatory clarity.[1]

items.title: Block faces approximately $964 million DOJ settlement cost
items.summary: Block reportedly reached an agreement in principle with the U.S. Department of Justice to defer prosecution in an anti-money-laundering investigation, with expected payments totaling roughly $964 million.[1]

items.title: South Korea considers delaying crypto income tax
items.summary: South Korean ruling-party leader Kim Min-seok said he formally proposed delaying the cryptocurrency income tax scheduled to begin on January 1, 2027.[1]

items.title: Morgan Stanley moves toward tokenized securities
items.summary: Morgan Stanley said it is among the first banks to tokenize U.S. equities and Treasuries through the DTCC’s Tokenization Service, signaling continued institutional adoption of blockchain-based market infrastructure.[1]

items.title: Shopify and Coinbase develop USDC commerce payments protocol
items.summary: Shopify and Coinbase are developing a Commerce Payments Protocol on Base intended to help merchants accept USDC payments.[1]

items.title: 56 companies oppose OKXICE tokenized stock plans
items.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, SoFi Technologies and Lam Research joined opposition to OKXICE’s proposed tokenized stock trading platform, bringing the number of objecting companies to 56.[6]

items.title: U.S. midterm results threaten crypto legislation prospects
items.summary: Democrats reportedly won control of both chambers of Congress, creating new uncertainty for the CLARITY Act and other proposed U.S. cryptocurrency legislation.[4]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: India launches three indigenous AI models for offline and critical-sector use
items.summary: India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B under the IndiaAI Mission. The models target mathematics, coding, reasoning, mobile offline access and secure deployments in sectors including defence, cybersecurity and banking.

items.title: Tencent rolls out Hy4 AI model
items.summary: Tencent launched Hy4, a flagship model designed to compete with leading open-weight systems and support agentic capabilities across its enterprise-software ecosystem. Reported features include vision and computer-use capabilities.

items.title: Anthropic introduces FlashProve for AI-output verification
items.summary: Anthropic unveiled FlashProve, an open-source research system that uses cryptographic model fingerprints to verify whether a specified model generated an output. The prototype supports mixture-of-experts models and responses up to 1,024 tokens.

items.title: Revolut reports 90% AI cost reduction with self-hosted models
items.summary: Revolut reportedly cut AI costs by 90% after deploying a self-hosted GLM model on 56 NVIDIA B200 GPUs. The reported inference cost was approximately $0.30 per million tokens for use by about 2,000 engineers.

items.title: Google expands AI-assisted drug-design tooling
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Cheminformatics Skills, combining an AI research agent with deterministic chemistry tools. The system was demonstrated in an hour-scale workflow for lung-cancer drug design.

items.title: Oracle reportedly scraps major Tencent AI-chip leasing deal
items.summary: Oracle reportedly abandoned a roughly $7 billion, five-year agreement to lease about 100,000 advanced AI chips to Tencent after pressure from the U.S. government. The development reflects intensifying geopolitical constraints on AI infrastructure and chip access.

items.title: OpenAI and Mazda begin AI-assisted vehicle-design research
items.summary: OpenAI and Mazda reportedly started a joint research project using GPT-6 Astra through Codex to generate vehicle front-end designs and evaluate options that could reduce aerodynamic drag.

items.title: Google changes default AI settings for K–12 students
items.summary: Google said its AI tools for K–12 students will be disabled by default in 2027, while schools that block Google AI entirely may lose access to Search. The policy highlights growing tensions over educational AI controls and platform dependence.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake arrives on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo is set to release a full remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2 as part of the franchise’s 40th anniversary. The remake reportedly includes updated visuals, voiced cutscenes, orchestral music and revised controls.

items.title: Bethesda reveals The Elder Scrolls VI subtitle and logo
items.summary: Bethesda officially unveiled The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel and showed its logo during the studio’s 40th-anniversary celebrations. The announcement did not provide a release date.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI preloading details reported
items.summary: Digital preloading for Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to begin November 10, with PlayStation 5 preloading starting at midnight local time and Xbox Series X|S preloading beginning at midnight GMT.

items.title: Borderlands franchise surpasses 100 million units sold
items.summary: The Borderlands series has passed 100 million units sold worldwide. Gearbox is continuing post-launch development for Borderlands 4, including story packs, bounty packs, new Vault Hunters and endgame content.

items.title: HoYoverse announces Petit Planet release date
items.summary: HoYoverse’s cozy galactic life-simulation game Petit Planet is scheduled to launch on December 4.
